raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  name: aiokafka
  version: "0.14.0"

package:
  name: ${{ name|lower }}
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/${{ name[0] }}/${{ name }}/${{ name }}-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 8ffdc945798ba4d3d132b705d4244d0a1f493925efb57c637a2ca88ee82794e1

build:
  number: 2
  script: ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv

requirements:
  build:
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then: python
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then: cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then: cython >=3.0.5
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then: zlib
    - ${{ compiler('c') }}
    - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
  host:
    - cython >=3.0.5
    - python
    - pip
    - setuptools
    - zlib
  run:
    - python
    - async-timeout
    - packaging
    - typing-extensions

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - aiokafka
      pip_check: true

about:
  license: Apache-2.0
  license_file: LICENSE
  summary: asyncio client for Kafka
  description: |
    AIOKafkaProducer is a high-level, asynchronous message producer.
  homepage: https://github.com/aio-libs/aiokafka
  repository: https://github.com/aio-libs/aiokafka

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - timkpaine
